title_en: Divine Unity in the Qur'an and Hadiths of the Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them)
description_en: Divine Unity in the Qur'an and Hadiths of the Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), from the program Al-Tawhid by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari, broadcast on Al-Kawthar TV.
summary: This lecture explores the concept of divine unity based on Qur'anic verses and narrations from the Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them).
